The '''''Vindicator''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it participated in a battle over [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], where it destroyed the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']].
